name: Kon Tum Wooden Church
summary: Walk the timber cathedral on Nguyen Hue, raised in cà chít wood from 1913 to 1918. Roman arches sit under a Ba Na roof, with stained glass and carved wood inside. Sunday times do not agree, so come between services for a quiet nave. How long to allow, and the gate fee, are Check on arrival. Keep the afternoon for Kon K'Tu if the village is the point of the day.
getThere: Walk from the centre along Nguyen Hue.
heroCaption: The timber façade and spire on Nguyen Hue

notice.title: Sunday Mass fills the nave
notice.body: Sunday services are at 5:00, 5:30, or 6:00, then at 7:30 or 8:00, then at 16:00 or 17:00. Come between them for a quiet look at the timber.

body: The cathedral stands at 13 Nguyen Hue. The ward is Thống Nhất, and also Kon Tum. It was raised from 1913 to 1918 in dark cà chít timber. The arches are Roman and the roof is Ba Na. Step inside for the stained glass and the carved wood.

Come between Sunday services if you want a quiet nave. Weekday Mass is at 5:00 and 17:30, and Saturday 17:30 is also on the clock. How long to allow, the hours outside Mass, and the gate fee are Check on arrival. Kon K'Tu is a different visit, across the Kon Klor bridge, for the afternoon.

figures.caption: The nave and sanctuary inside the wooden church
figures.alt: Timber columns, stained glass, and the sanctuary inside Kon Tum Wooden Church

gettingThere: The church is at 13 Nguyen Hue, in the centre of town. Walk from the centre. From Pleiku Airport, the bus or taxi into Kon Tum takes about an hour, or 1 to 1.5 hours by car and about 1.5 hours by bus.

legs.heading: From the centre
legs.body: Walk along Nguyen Hue to number 13.

legs.heading: From Pleiku Airport (PXU)
legs.body: By bus or taxi to the centre. The road is nearly 45 km, or 51 km, about an hour, or 50 km in 1 to 1.5 hours by car and about 1.5 hours by bus. Then walk.

hours: Weekday Mass is at 5:00 and 17:30. Sunday Mass is at 5:00, 5:30, or 6:00, then at 7:30 or 8:00, then at 16:00 or 17:00. Saturday 17:30 is also on the clock. Hours outside Mass: Check on arrival.
